name: Marginalia
tagline: Linked Markdown notes for writers, students and researchers
description: For writers, students and researchers whose ideas span many notes. It keeps sources and drafts connected through wiki links, backlinks and a graph, without an account or a server.
scope: Wiki links, backlinks and link graph
Version history, trash and file import
features: Hand-written Markdown parser with nested lists, tables and tasks you tick in the preview
[[Wiki links]] with autocomplete, creation from unresolved links, and a backlinks panel
Renaming a note rewrites every link to it, keeps aliases and leaves code untouched
Ranked search across titles, tags, headings and text, with highlighted snippets
Force-directed SVG graph of linked notes: click to open, drag to rearrange
Version history with line diffs and restore, plus trash, pinning, and .md and JSON import and export
engineering: A hand-written Markdown parser implements CommonMark's delimiter rules for emphasis, escapes all source text by construction, allowlists URL schemes, and tracks source line numbers through nested blocks so a preview checkbox edits the right line.
